test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 05 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Tyrany must be dead to attain harmony, tranquillity, and serenity.
solution:
The correct answer is: **tyrany**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling should be "**tyranny**"
 
• **Tyranny**: Cruel and oppressive government or rule. (क्रूर और दमनकारी सरकार या शासन)

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2, which is incorrectly spelled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Tranquillity**: A peaceful, calm state, without noise, violence, worry, etc. (एक शांतिपूर्ण, शांत राज्य, बिना शोर, हिंसा, चिंता आदि के)
 
• **Serenity**: The state of being calm, peaceful, and untroubled. (शांत, शांतिपूर्ण और अशांत होने की अवस्था)
 
• **Harmony**: A state of peaceful existence and agreement. (शांतिपूर्ण अस्तित्व और समझौते की स्थिति)
